subject: Temporary attestation & secure drop onboarding for SOC 2 Type II

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestlinehealth.com>, IT Security <it-security@crestlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary attestation & secure drop onboarding for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock procurement/security: 

- Crestline ask: confirm SOC 2 Type II evidence and provide interim materials your procurement team needs (bridge/attestation + secure drop)
- Our status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II audit fieldwork in February; official Type II report is scheduled for delivery by 2028-05-15. We can provide a signed temporary attestation and a high-level summary of controls today.

Action items I can take on immediately:
1) Share a short attestation PDF (temporary) and a one-page SOC 2 Type II summary for procurement.
2) Provision secure-drop instructions (SFTP/one-time upload) or invite you to our Trust Portal — whichever you prefer.
3) Kick off a short vendor security questionnaire (if you send the file I’ll assign to our compliance team).

Please confirm whether Procurement prefers a Trust Portal invite or a secure-drop for evidence. If you already have a vendor security questionnaire, please attach it in reply and I’ll route to our compliance lead (CC’d: Marissa).

Attachments: PostDemo-Notes.txt (summarized call notes)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestlinehealth.com>

Date: 2028-03-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary attestation & secure drop onboarding for SOC 2 Type II

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. Procurement is looking for the following before we can finalize the legal paperwork: 

- Signed temporary attestation describing current SOC 2 Type II status (so we have a short-term commitment while we wait for the final report)
- Either a bridge letter or, if unavailable, a statement about expected delivery date for the full report (that’s fine)
- Access to whatever evidence your team can share now (control summaries, test evidence where feasible) via a secure channel (we prefer a Trust Portal invite but can accept SFTP drop)
- Our vendor security questionnaire (attached — VSAQ_Crestline_2028.xlsx) — please have your compliance/security team complete.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) provide a signed temporary attestation today, and 2) invite Crestline to the Trust Portal (preferred)? Also please confirm what level of evidence will be available immediately vs. in May.

Thanks — Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director, Information Security | Crestline Health
lena.ortiz@crestlinehealth.com
Attachment: VSAQ_Crestline_2028.xlsx (vendor security questionnaire)

Suggested internal plan:
- I can send the temporary attestation and control-summary PDF once you sign off on language. I expect we should not include detailed test artifacts yet, just the high-level control summaries and the temporary attestation referencing expected delivery date (2028-05-15).
- Marissa: could you / compliance provide the attestation signature and confirm which evidence folders we can expose in the portal (Summary docs + selected artifacts only)?
- If compliance prefers, we can set up a secure drop instead and hand off credentials/instructions. I’ll coordinate the Trust Portal invite after your go-ahead.

Attachments: draft_temp_attestation_for_crestline.docx (draft attestation text)

Cheers,
Aditya
